test_path: (no dedicated unit test — Inngest serve() shim). Function registration verified indirectly by inngest_client.json + inngest_cronDaily.json + inngest_cronLive.json + inngest_cronWhatsapp.json + inngest_eventBackfill.json + inngest_eventSyncNow.json.

findings.failing_input: A new Inngest function is added in src/inngest/functions/ but its export is forgotten in the serve() functions array.
findings.expected: A test (or graphify check) flags the orphan.
findings.actual: No test pins the registered set. The phase 12 channel sweep (CHANNELS.md) is the implicit safety net. Manual review only.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a test that imports every src/inngest/functions/**/* default-export + spread-export and asserts they all appear in serve()'s functions array. Alternative: a build-time graphify check.
findings.regression_test_idea: describe('all Inngest functions registered'): import.meta.glob('@/inngest/functions/**/*.ts') → flat-map → expect serve config to include each.

findings.failing_input: Vercel plan downgrades from Pro to Hobby.
findings.expected: Operator alert if maxDuration=60 is silently ignored.
findings.actual: The 60s ceiling depends on the Vercel plan; the comment notes this on lines 36-41 but there's no runtime check. Large-day Shopify fetches would silently truncate.
findings.fix_sketch: Optional — runtime cap detection requires Vercel API call. Not worth the complexity for an internal tool with operator-known plan.

uncertainty_notes: Route is a thin shim — all complexity sits in the imported function modules. Signing-key validation is automatic via serve(). The dynamic-opt-in absence is intentional per RESEARCH §Pitfall 11 (well-documented in the file-level comment).
test_coverage_gaps: No test that the registered functions match the file system (orphan-detection).

No test for the env-var assertion (INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY required for serve() validation). The serve() helper handles this internally but missing env should fail loud at startup, not lazily on first POST.

exports_to: GET/POST/PUT handlers → Inngest cloud invokes them
